title: Source register and confidence grading
description: The shared evidence model. Both modules grade every asset A-D by how the geometry was obtained, not by how good it looks. Generalised from manhattan-bridge-3d/CONFIDENCE-MODEL.md so that repository can adopt this contract without regrading anything.

grades.description: Normative definition of the four grades. Reproduced in every register so a consumer never has to guess.

weakest_link_rule.description: Normative and non-negotiable: an asset's confidence is the MINIMUM of its own basis grade and the grade of every control value it consumes. Build scripts MUST enforce this.

tier_rule.const: No Tier C source may override Tier A geometry.
tier_rule.description: Restates the source hierarchy rule from both AGENT-INSTRUCTIONS.md files.

source_id.description: Stable register ID, e.g. 'SRC-001' or 'DSRC-001'. Module prefixes MUST be distinct so IDs never collide across modules.

tier.description: Source hierarchy tier. A = authoritative official data, B = imagery and secondary reference, C = derived or reconstructed.

license.description: SPDX identifier where one exists, otherwise a short name. Required so downstream redistribution stays lawful.

attribution_text.description: Exact credit line a viewer MUST display when this source contributes to rendered geometry.

grants_confidence.description: The highest confidence an asset derived solely from this source may claim.
